newsitem.title: Philippines: RESEARCH ALERT - Univeral Robina rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Univeral Robina rated buy.

text.p: Food manufacturing concern, Universal Robina Corp (URC), was rated a buy by Sun Hung Kai Securities on Thursday.
URC is a unit of JG Summit Holdings Inc.
In an advisory to clients, the brokerage house said that based on its closing price of 13.50 pesos on Wednesday, URC is trading at 13.2 times forecast 1997 earnings of 1.523 billion pesos.

It said URC's recently announced packaging project could result in cost savings for URC considering that packaging is a significant component in snack food production. Moreover, it complements with J.G. Summit's petrochem project from which it will source its raw materials.
The securities firm, howver, said it cannot estimate yet the amount of savings from the project.
